brand.name: OctoEverywhere
page.title: AI print failure detection
page.description: Let Gadget keep an eye on your prints.
account.title: Connect to OctoEverywhere
account.description: Two quick steps, then choose the printers Gadget watches.
account.readOnly: You can view monitoring. Ask a Connect administrator to manage the connection.
account.keyStored: Your Gadget API key is saved on this Connect server.
account.keyHelp: Sign in to OctoEverywhere and copy your Gadget API key.
account.keyPrivacy: Sent securely to this server for validation. Your saved key is never displayed here.
account.keyMissing: A Connect administrator needs to add a Gadget API key.
account.keySaved: Your Gadget API key is verified and saved.
account.cameraReady: Gadget can read snapshots from your Connect cameras.
account.cameraHelp: Add a read-only Connect API token so the extension can read camera snapshots while your browser is closed.
account.tokenHelp: Create a token in Connect's API token settings. Give it read access to the cameras you want to monitor, then paste it below.
account.urlHelp: This is the address the extension uses from the server. To change it, open Settings → Extensions → OctoEverywhere → Settings and edit connect_url.
account.cameraNext: Connect your Gadget account first, then allow camera access.
account.connectSaved: Camera access is verified and saved.
account.summary: Monitoring enabled for {count} printers. Choose a camera for each printer below.
setup.howBody: Gadget checks snapshots of your active prints for signs of failure. Results appear here, with a history of warnings and actions.
setup.controlBody: Choose which printers to watch. Automatic pausing starts off; turn it on for each printer when you're ready. Monitoring starts automatically after a warm-up buffer, based on the printer's reported state and progress.
setup.privacyBody: Monitoring sends snapshots to OctoEverywhere's Gadget API for analysis. Under our strict image privacy policy, images are deleted immediately after processing. They are never stored afterward, used for AI training, or sold.
printers.title: Your printers
printers.description: Choose what Gadget watches and how it responds.
printers.emptyBody: Add a printer in Connect, or ask an administrator to give this extension access. Then refresh this page.
printer.warningHelp: Gadget spotted a possible problem. Check the camera and your printer before continuing.
printer.pauseSuggested: Gadget recommends pausing this print. Check its current state and camera in Connect; a recommendation does not mean the printer has paused.
printer.firstLayerTitle: Waiting for the print to get going
printer.firstLayerHelp: Gadget starts automatically after the warm-up buffer and reported print progress. This estimates when printing begins; Connect does not identify when the first layer begins.
printer.quotaHelp: Monitoring is paused because the Gadget account has reached a usage limit.
printer.readOnly: You can view this printer. Ask a Connect administrator to change its monitoring settings.
printer.enableHelp: Check this printer's camera while a print is running.
printer.setupFirst: Complete the account and camera connection above before enabling monitoring.
printer.cameraHelp: Choose a camera with a clear view of the print bed.
printer.noCameraHelp: Add a camera on this printer's Cameras tab in Connect, then refresh this page.
printer.saveBeforeTest: Save your camera choice before testing it.
printer.autoPauseHelp: Allow Gadget to request a pause when it detects a likely failure. Off by default. In Connect, an administrator must also grant this extension operator access to this printer.
printer.confidenceHelp: 1 reacts sooner; 5 needs more confidence. Start with 3 for both. Confidence changes apply to the next print.
printer.warmupHelp: Wait before analyzing a new print. Default: 180 seconds. Use 60–1800 seconds to allow for your printer's heating and preparation. The start is estimated from reported printing state and progress.
printer.cameraPassed: Camera test passed. A snapshot is available for Gadget.
history.title: Recent activity
history.description: Monitoring updates, warnings, and pause requests.
history.emptyHelp: Gadget's activity will appear here once monitoring starts.
